scope: Entire saved snapshot; not clipped to a 2km circle. Counts are OSM objects, not distinct physical facilities.

graph.length_note: Sum of edge lengths divided by two, including repeated segments if distinct OSM ways overlap; not a deduplicated physical road inventory.

limitations: Snapshot query does not prove all entrances/barriers/kerbs/relations in the area were requested. Zero counts can be extraction omissions as well as unmapped attributes.
No new OSM observation or live element history was fetched.
Counts and lengths do not establish actual wheelchair access.
Element edit metadata is absent; snapshot timestamp is not field survey date.
